Shimmering platinum white hair, long and flowing with straight-cut bangs. Luminous pale gold eyes with a serene, distant expression. Appears in the early twenties with a mature, ethereal countenance. Slender, graceful build. Wears an ornate white and gold silk robe with translucent layered sleeves. Features a golden circlet upon the brow and a floating crystalline orb.
BODY COLOR: pale porcelain
